name: omnilab/iucn
description: Omnilab IUCN Red List: a taxon of the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species by its SIS id or scientific name - classification, authority, common names, synonyms, assessing group - with its latest global assessment (Red List category, criteria, population trend, year, possibly extinct, citation), through the Red List API v4 with the user's API token.
